# Roadbook Nav

> Free, offline-first digital roadbook for motorcycle rally, enduro and trail riding. Plan waypoints on a map at home, send the route to your phone with a QR code, and navigate with one large direction arrow and a live distance countdown — no mobile signal, no account, no tracking.

Roadbook Nav is a progressive web app (PWA) that runs in any modern browser and can be installed to the home screen on Android and iOS.

## Key facts

- Navigation runs fully offline once the app is installed: no map tiles, no network requests while riding. Distance is computed from GPS with the Haversine formula (straight-line distance to the next waypoint).
- The route editor needs internet (OpenStreetMap tiles) and is meant to be used before the ride.
- Each waypoint has a symbol (start, finish, straight, slight/normal/sharp left or right, keep left/right at a fork, roundabout with exit number, U-turn), an optional label and an optional hazard mark (!, !!, !!!).
- Auto-advance trigger radius: 15, 25 (default) or 50 m. If a waypoint is narrowly missed, it still counts as passed once the rider clearly moves away.
- Approach warning about 9 seconds before each waypoint, based on current speed; hazard waypoints get a distinct warning sound.
- Rally-style trip meter from GPS with ±10 m correction, shown next to the planned route distance.
- Progress is saved during the ride; after an interruption the app offers to resume at the same waypoint.
- The ridden track can be downloaded as GPX after the ride.
- Sunlight mode (black on white), landscape layout, large glove-friendly buttons, hold-to-skip.
- Preview mode steps through a roadbook without GPS.
- Routes can be shared as a link or QR code; the route is compressed into the link itself, nothing is uploaded.
- Import: Roadbook Nav JSON and GPX (as overlay, plus roadbook waypoints exported from Roadbook Nav). Export: JSON and GPX.
- Data stays on the device (localStorage and exported files). No account, no server, no location sharing.
- Not a turn-by-turn road navigator and does not show a moving map while navigating.
- Price: free.
